comment: Structured media slots consumed by src/components/DocMedia.astro.
Every documentation <DocMedia id="..." /> resolves through this file.
Session 21 (next capture session) walks items[].capture, drives the
studio at PUBLIC_APP_URL through Playwright, and writes public/media/
<id>.png (screenshot) or <id>.gif (gif). Until then every slot renders
the Stitch technical illustration declared as `fallback`.

items.alt: RDM Studio workspace at the Geometry step with the portal-frame quick-start template loaded
items.caption: The 5-step workspace right after the first quick-start template — geometry, sections, units.

items.alt: Animated capture of the Calcul button running the solver and the Results step appearing
items.caption: One click on Calculer: the Cholesky solve, deformed shape and EC3 rates render in under 20 ms.

capture.actions: click 'Calculer', wait 1200 ms, screenshot 3 frames at 400 ms interval

items.alt: 3D lifting-cradle model with the (ax, ay, az) × g acceleration field panel open
items.caption: Naval cradle tutorial model: two transverses, cargo mass, acceleration field panel.

capture.actions: open Load generators → Champs d'accélération (g), set (0, 0.4, 1.3) × g

items.alt: CAD toolbar with magnetic snap active and the DXF import dialog over the 3D viewport
items.caption: Magnetic snap reticles (node square, midpoint triangle, grid crosshair) and DXF import.

capture.actions: hover a beam midpoint, open the DXF import dialog

items.alt: Eurocode 3 Pareto optimizer dialog with the section candidates table
items.caption: 1-click Pareto optimizer: mass vs EC3 utilization candidates, 1-click apply with undo.

capture.actions: select the governing beam, open the Optimizer dialog

items.alt: RDM 7 supports library with the 6-DOF restraint matrix editor open
items.caption: RDM 7 library: 6-DOF restraints (Ux, Uy, Uz, Rx, Ry, Rz) and elastic springs kx…krz.

capture.actions: open Supports step, open the RDM 7 library popover on node N1

items.alt: Load generators panel with EN 1991 wind, snow and thermal entries plus the EN 1990 combinations table
items.caption: EN 1991 generators (vb, sk, ΔT), acceleration fields and the 6.10 / 6.10a+b combinations.

capture.actions: open Loads step, expand Générateurs EN 1991

items.alt: 3D deformed shape with the 5-tier thermal spectrum and uPlot My/Vz/N diagrams docked below
items.caption: Results step: deformed shape, thermal spectrum, synchronized uPlot internal force diagrams.

capture.actions: solve, open Results step, scrub the cutting plane to 0.50 L

items.alt: 2D cross-section cut with the Von Mises σvM / fy heatmap
items.caption: Section cut at x = 0,50 L: 2D Von Mises heatmap normalized by fy.

capture.actions: solve, Results step, cutting plane 0.50 L, section cut panel

items.alt: CalcTrace tree with the EN 1993-1-1 6.61 clause opened as KaTeX formulas
items.caption: CalcTrace: every EC3 clause unfolds into step-by-step KaTeX formulas with sources.

capture.actions: solve, open the EC3 verification panel, expand clause 6.61

items.alt: Lateral-torsional buckling panel showing Mcr, lambda-LT-bar and chi-LT curves
items.caption: LTB verification: Mcr, λ̄LT and χLT on the rolled-section curve.

capture.actions: solve, open the LTB verification of the governing beam

items.alt: Modal analysis table listing f1..f6 eigenfrequencies and the first mode 3D shape
items.caption: Modal analysis: f₁…f₆ eigenfrequencies and the animated first mode.

items.alt: Linear buckling panel showing lambda-cr and the first global buckling mode
items.caption: Global linear buckling: λcr and the amplified first mode shape.

items.alt: Multi-material checks panel with EC2, EC5, EC9 and EC3-1-2 fire verification entries
items.caption: Multi-material checks in one model: EC2 concrete, EC5 timber, EC9 aluminium, EC3-1-2 fire.

items.alt: Generated A4 vector PDF calculation note with firm branding and SHA-256 fingerprint
items.caption: The A4 calculation note: cover, reactions, EC3 rates, SHA-256 fingerprint.

capture.actions: solve, open Report step, generate the Takumi PDF preview

items.alt: Exports panel listing IFC4, SAF, OpenSees TCL, glTF, .rdm and CSV export buttons
items.caption: BIM & interoperability exports: IFC4, SAF, OpenSees TCL, glTF, .rdm, CSV.

items.alt: Validation modal with the 41/41 benchmark certification table and domain filter
items.caption: The 41-benchmark certification view, filtered on the RDM & flambement domain.

capture.actions: open the 41/41 validation modal, select the RDM filter

items.alt: Command palette (Cmd-K) open over the 3D workspace with quick actions
items.caption: ⌘K palette: navigate, toggle layers, run the solver, switch locale.

items.alt: DevTools performance trace of a sub-20-millisecond Cholesky solve inside the WASM worker
items.caption: The solver at work: < 20 ms Cholesky LDLᵀ factorization, all inside the browser tab.

capture.actions: solve with the performance panel open
